title: How to Be an Antiracist
author: Ibram X. Kendi
summary: Ibram X. Kendi combines memoir with a framework for understanding racist ideas and policies. He argues that being neutral is not an option and that the work is to challenge inequity in its many forms.
readIf: you want a personal, definition-driven argument about race that you can debate with others.
skipIf: you want a neutral survey of competing views or a purely historical account.
